meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把已解析的结构化文档转成四色卡片：蓝卡记事实、绿卡作解释、黄卡列风险、红卡给行动，每张卡片附来源片段，可溯源。
howto.when: 当你撰写金融研报或分析法律文档，并要基于结构化文档生成四色卡片报告时触发。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns a parsed structured document into four-color cards: blue for facts, green for explanation, yellow for risks, red for actions, each with source snippets so it can be traced.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you draft a financial research report or analyze a legal document and need a four-color card report built from a parsed structured document.

say_en.text: Turn this document into a four-color card report
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow and red cards

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull blue-card facts
say_en.note: Runs the TongZhengSi agent for fact cards
